_comment: CELPIP Writing Task 1: Writing an Email. Each item is a situation and the three things the email must do.

items.prompt: You recently ordered a laptop from an online store. When it arrived, the screen was cracked. Write an email to the store's customer service department.
bullets: Describe what you ordered and when it arrived
Explain what is wrong with it
Say what you would like the store to do

items.prompt: Your new neighbour often plays loud music late at night, and it keeps you awake. Write an email to your neighbour.
bullets: Introduce yourself
Explain the problem and how it affects you
Suggest a solution that would work for both of you

items.prompt: A friend from another country is going to visit your city for one week next month. Write an email to your friend.
bullets: Recommend two or three places to visit
Explain what kind of weather to expect and what to pack
Offer to help with something during the visit

items.prompt: You need to take a week off work next month for a family reason. Write an email to your manager.
bullets: Explain why you need the time off
Suggest how your work could be covered while you are away
Ask when you can expect an answer

items.prompt: Your local community centre is asking residents to suggest a new free program. Write an email to the centre's director.
bullets: Describe the program you would like to see
Explain who would benefit from it and why
Say what the centre would need to run it

items.prompt: The heating in your apartment stopped working three days ago, and the weather is very cold. Write an email to your landlord.
bullets: Describe the problem and when it started
Explain how it is affecting you and your family
Ask for a repair and say when you are available

items.prompt: A coworker finished an important project for you while you were sick last week. Write an email to your coworker.
bullets: Thank them for their help
Explain how their help made a difference
Suggest a way to show your appreciation

items.prompt: The park near your home is in poor condition: the paths are broken and the playground equipment is old. Write an email to your city councillor.
bullets: Describe the problems in the park
Explain why the park is important to the neighbourhood
Suggest improvements the city could make

items.prompt: You registered and paid for an evening course at a local college, but you can no longer attend because your work schedule has changed. Write an email to the college's registration office.
bullets: Give the details of the course you registered for
Explain why you cannot attend
Ask about a refund or moving to a later course

items.prompt: A close friend has invited you to their wedding, but you will be out of the country on that date. Write an email to your friend.
bullets: Congratulate your friend
Explain why you cannot attend
Suggest another way to celebrate with them
